scope: F1: closed Bar through quality, inclusion, fractal, strict stroke, segment and frozen L0 under CompleteBoundary
authority: Original lessons are primary. The reference implementation supplies documented engineering choices where the original does not prescribe scheduling details.

decisions.topic: Initial three strokes and unknown initial inclusion direction
decisions.decision: Reject a declared start whose first three confirmed strokes have no common overlap; never silently change the root. Reject NoNetDisplacement before consuming the first Bar.
decisions.basis: Lessons 65 and 77; F02 and F10; explicit CompleteBoundary contract
decisions.verification: f1_start_e2e; before-fix replay published invalid L0 in both directions

decisions.topic: Earlier unresolved boundary versus later recognized candidate
decisions.decision: An earlier formed primary fractal in SeekingSecond or SeekingActualBreak blocks later publication until it confirms or is invalidated.
decisions.basis: Lessons 67, 71, 78 plus the explicit scheduling choice in ChanSegmentCalculator::cal_seg_sure and treat_fx_eigen; Kimi followup supports this choice without treating it as a verbatim original rule
decisions.verification: 67-pending-gap-blocks-later-lower-peak and 71-pending-real-break-blocks-later-lower-peak, mirrored full Bar replays; candidate invalidation remains covered

decisions.topic: Second fractal and new extreme occur in the same confirmed stroke
decisions.decision: Keep recognition before invalidation when a strict second fractal is already present. Do not adopt the review suggestion to unconditionally discard first.
decisions.basis: Lesson 78 conditions continuation on the absence of the second fractal. The collision fixture has that fractal; the reference find_revert_fx likewise tests it. A new extreme before any second fractal still invalidates the candidate.

decisions.topic: Single-price overlap and strict real break
decisions.decision: Closed intervals touching at one price overlap and have no gap; a real directional break is strict. These are different predicates.
decisions.basis: Selected profile and reference EigenFx::update_fx/actual_break. The local real-break witness is not claimed to reproduce the general lesson-65 dj<=gi definition by itself.

decisions.decision: Use ordinary inclusion and strict fractals, without recursively requiring another second sequence. Replayed successor segments share endpoints and preserve publication time order.
decisions.basis: Lessons 67, 77 and 78. Do not copy the reference implementation's contrary inclusion/recursion behavior.
decisions.verification: Second gap, inclusion and equal-high fixtures; the gap-open fixture checks its first three completed segments

decisions.decision: Retain the minimal original Bar price/time projection and compute the range over the raw endpoint-time interval, including its endpoint Bars. Exclude Bars after the endpoint even if later absorbed into the same combined K line.
decisions.basis: Lesson 78 and F06/F19: actual internal extremes need not be selected endpoints or survive inclusion
decisions.verification: segment_range_e2e: four before-fix failures cover short unqualified reversals, discarded inclusion extremes, mirrored directions and post-endpoint exclusion

boundaries: Uses the documented strict stroke profile, conservative online fractal/stroke freezing and explicit CompleteBoundary.
Synthetic numerical structures instantiate original rules; they do not claim pixel-exact reconstruction of historical diagrams.
The finite real OHLC replay checks the formal pipeline and invariants, not an independent oracle for every original semantic case.
No F2 implementation, new formal proof, annual market replay or performance acceptance is claimed.
The reference repository was not modified.
